why: Scripts that are BUILT and REACHABLE but that no npm script, workflow, hook or sibling ever runs. support-audit cannot see this class: importing a module makes it "supported" while nothing exercises what it does — books.ts sat here for months at 302/302 supported. Declared 2026-08-19; this list MAY ONLY SHRINK. A script leaves it by being wired into a chain, or by being exercised and proven green. EXERCISING IS THE POINT, not excusing: of the first six run, TWO were broken — quantum-dimension-scan read dist/test, a directory deleted earlier the same day, and seal-claims-audit was holding a real finding (1308 of 1327 KEYS claimed — 1243 distinct propositions under 1327 keys, 84 deliberate re-namings). Both are fixed and removed from this list. The remainder are owed the same treatment.
exercised_and_fixed: seal-claims-audit.ts (now WIRED into the audit chain — it caught a real gap, so it earns a permanent slot)
quantum-dimension-scan.ts (fixed and proven green; stays on-demand, declared below)
